metadata.title: Triple bubbles in the hyperbolic plane
metadata.abstract: We prove that the standard triple bubble uniquely minimizes perimeter among clusters in the hyperbolic plane with three prescribed positive finite areas. The standard family admits global pressure coordinates, and its volume differential is the negative of a positive definite grounded weighted graph Laplacian. A normalized perimeter excess attains a comparison minimum under a perimeter bound and gives a strict comparison between actual and model pressures. Component relabeling reduces the possible topologies to an all-boundary network or a 4-daisy. Discrete comparisons exclude the 4-daisy; pressure-preserving face deletion reduces the remaining network to the standard tetrahedral configuration.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.progressType: 全局等周极小与唯一性
analysis.workSummary: 作者声称双曲平面中三个指定正有限面积的泡簇，周长由标准三泡唯一极小。标准族具有全局压力坐标，体积微分为正定接地加权图Laplacian的负值。归一化周长盈余在周长受控类中达到比较极小，导出实际压力与模型压力的严格比较；通过分量重标记将拓扑化为全边界网络或四雏菊配置，排除后者并以保压删面约化到标准四面体配置。
analysis.breakthrough: 若论证成立，则解决双曲平面三泡的全局周长极小及唯一性，并给出处理复杂拓扑的压力方法。
analysis.limitations: 需三个面积均正且有限；摘要未说明唯一性的精确等距等价约定，也未给出所有泡簇正则性及存在性的证明细节。不能推广到更高维或任意泡数。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
